Official Announcement · New Leadership

New Ownership Announcement

Harborlight Foundation is pleased to share an official statement regarding the transition to new leadership and ownership under Eric Vince, reaffirming our commitment to dignity, community care, and lasting support.

“This new chapter represents more than just a change of ownership; it represents a commitment to growth, compassion, positive impact, and making a meaningful difference in the lives of people experiencing homelessness.”

— Eric Vince, New Owner

How we help

Meeting immediate needs. Making room for what’s next.

Hardship rarely has one cause. Our response brings essential support together with a respectful, person-led path forward.

01

Safe nights

Connecting people without secure housing to emergency shelter, essentials and help finding a safer next step.

02

Everyday essentials

Food, hygiene supplies and practical assistance for individuals and families navigating immediate hardship.

03

Pathways forward

One-to-one guidance and community partnerships that support access to services, stability and opportunity.

Our approach
“Support should meet people where they are—and help open the next door.”

We believe effective aid is grounded in respect, consistency and local knowledge. Our teams listen first, respond to urgent needs and work with trusted community partners to help people take their next steps.

We are committed to treating every person with dignity and sharing clear information about how contributions support our work.

Founder & Director: Thomas Stewart · Our commitment: care that is practical, accountable and centered on people.
